note: General patterns, written to be recognisable in any area of life, before any archive is read. They describe what can be observed in an account — a circumstance and what followed — and nothing about the person. Several are drawn from what clinical and behavioural literatures describe, but no pattern names a condition and no count of matches is evidence of one: a journal cannot diagnose, and this does not try. A pattern is a question asked of an account, never a label attached to its author.

patterns.name: Attention taken by the unfamiliar
patterns.statement: Something not yet automatic was taking their attention while information arrived.
holds_when: the person was managing something they had not done often
something was said, shown or signalled while they were occupied with it
they acted on part of what arrived, or asked for it again
not_when: the information was never delivered
they took it in fully and chose to ignore it
the task was familiar and required no deliberate handling
patterns.question: Was there an occasion when you were handling something unfamiliar and still took in everything that arrived?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of handling something unfamiliar with nothing missed

patterns.name: Acting before the information was complete
patterns.statement: A response was made while something needed to judge it was still missing.
holds_when: they knew a detail was absent or unclear when they acted
the missing part arrived later and changed the picture
they acted rather than waited or asked
not_when: everything needed was present and was read
the missing part turned out not to matter and they knew that
they deliberately waited until it arrived
patterns.question: Was there an occasion when you waited for the missing part instead of acting, and what made that possible?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of routinely waiting for the missing part

patterns.name: Settled in advance, or worked out in the moment
patterns.statement: What to do was decided before the occasion rather than during it, leaving less to work out while it was happening.
holds_when: a rule, plan or choice existed before the occasion began
during the occasion they applied it rather than deliberating
what remained to judge was narrower than it would have been
not_when: the plan was made during the occasion
a plan existed and was abandoned as it began
nothing had to be decided either way
patterns.question: Was there an occasion where deciding beforehand made no difference, or made things worse?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account where deciding in advance changed nothing

patterns.name: Committed more than could be taken back
patterns.statement: More was committed — of what they had, of their time, attention or word — than could be withdrawn without a cost.
holds_when: withdrawing would have cost something real
the size of the commitment was noticed at the time or afterwards
less room was left to respond to what happened next
not_when: the commitment could be undone freely
it was large but within what they could set aside
the size was decided by someone else
patterns.question: What size of commitment leaves you able to change your mind without it costing you?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account where a large commitment left full freedom to respond

patterns.name: Continuing in the same direction after a setback
patterns.statement: Something went against them, and they carried on in the same direction rather than stopping or changing it.
holds_when: a loss, refusal or failure had already happened
the next action continued the same course
stopping or changing course was available
not_when: the setback had not happened yet
they stopped, paused or changed approach
continuing was the only option available
patterns.question: Was there an occasion when you stopped after a setback, and what made stopping possible then?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of stopping after a setback as a matter of course

patterns.name: Ease now against a cost later
patterns.statement: They took the option that was easier at the time.
holds_when: one option was easier right then
they took it
the account says what followed later
not_when: the easier option was also better later
the later cost is not described
there was no easier option
patterns.question: Was there an occasion when the easier option turned out to be the better one?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account where taking the easier option cost nothing later

patterns.name: Doing the demanding thing while depleted
patterns.statement: They did something demanding while tired, foggy or unwilling.
holds_when: they describe being tired, foggy, unwilling or overwhelmed
they did the demanding thing anyway
the account says what followed
not_when: they were rested and willing
they did not do it
the demand was trivial
patterns.question: Was there an occasion when doing it while depleted made things worse rather than better?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account where pushing through while depleted went badly

patterns.name: A signal arrived and was acted on, or was not
patterns.statement: Something they could see or feel said what to do.
holds_when: a sign, rule or bodily cue was noticed at the time
the account says whether it was followed or set aside
what followed is described
not_when: the sign was noticed only in hindsight
no sign is described
there was nothing to act on
patterns.question: What makes the difference between a signal you act on and one you set aside?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account where acting on signals made no difference either way

patterns.name: Begun only once it could not be put off
patterns.statement: The thing was started when there was no room left to delay it.
holds_when: it had been available to start for a while
the start came close to a deadline, a departure or a consequence
the account says what the finished thing was like
not_when: it was started as soon as it arrived
nothing forced the timing
there was no earlier opportunity to begin
patterns.question: Was there something you began long before you had to, and what was different that time?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of beginning something with no pressure to
patterns.basis: Described in work on delay and deadline-driven starting.

patterns.name: Absorbed, with time passing unnoticed
patterns.statement: They were taken up in something and noticed afterwards how long had passed.
holds_when: the account mentions losing track of time or looking up late
the absorption was in one activity
what followed is described
not_when: they were watching the clock throughout
the time was scheduled and kept
they were interrupted early
patterns.question: What was present in the occasions where you stayed absorbed and still stopped on time?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of deep absorption with the time kept
patterns.basis: Described in work on sustained attention and immersion.

patterns.name: A routine broke and the day changed shape
patterns.statement: Something that usually happens did not, and the rest of the day went differently.
holds_when: a regular part of the day was missed, moved or blocked
the account connects it to how the rest went
what followed is described
not_when: the routine held
the change was planned and prepared for
nothing about the day is described
patterns.question: Was there a day a routine broke and the rest of it went as usual?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of a broken routine with no difference after it
patterns.basis: Described in work on routine, transitions and the cost of switching.

patterns.name: Moving between things took longer than the things
patterns.statement: Getting from one activity to the next took time or effort of its own.
holds_when: the account mentions the gap between two activities
the difficulty was in starting the next rather than doing it
what followed is described
not_when: one thing followed another without comment
the difficulty was in the activity itself
there was only one activity
patterns.question: Was there a day you moved between things easily, and what was different about it?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of moving between activities with no friction
patterns.basis: Described in work on task switching and transitions.

patterns.name: The surroundings made the difference
patterns.statement: Noise, light, crowding or quiet is given as part of how the occasion went.
holds_when: the account names something about the surroundings
it is connected to how the occasion went
what followed is described
not_when: the surroundings are mentioned only as scene-setting
nothing about the setting is given
the setting was chosen and had no effect described
patterns.question: Was there an occasion in the same surroundings that went the other way?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account where the same setting produced the opposite outcome
patterns.basis: Described in work on sensory environment and performance.

patterns.name: Put off, and the relief was immediate
patterns.statement: Something was avoided and the account says the relief came at once.
holds_when: there was a thing they meant to do or face
they did not do it
the account describes feeling better straight away, or worse later
not_when: the thing was done
it was dropped deliberately and stayed dropped
no relief or later cost is described
patterns.question: Was there something you put off that cost you nothing at all?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of avoidance with no later cost
patterns.basis: Described in behavioural accounts of avoidance and short-term relief.

patterns.name: Faced, and it was smaller than expected
patterns.statement: Something anticipated as hard was approached, and the account says how it compared.
holds_when: the account gives an expectation beforehand
they went ahead
the account compares it with what was expected
not_when: no expectation is described
they did not go ahead
the comparison is absent
patterns.question: Was there something that turned out exactly as hard as you expected, or worse?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of something facing up to being as bad as feared
patterns.basis: Described in work on exposure and expectancy.

patterns.name: Gone over repeatedly without anything new
patterns.statement: The same occasion was thought about again and again without new information arriving.
holds_when: the account says they kept returning to it
nothing new was learned between the returns
what followed is described
not_when: each return brought something new
it was thought about once and set down
they were working out a decision with fresh material
patterns.question: What was present on the occasions you thought something through once and let it go?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of returning to something repeatedly and reaching something new
patterns.basis: Described in work on repetitive thought.

patterns.name: It worked often enough to keep doing it
patterns.statement: The same approach went well on some occasions and badly on others, and both are recorded.
holds_when: the account describes an approach used more than once
at least one occasion went well
at least one went badly
not_when: it went the same way every time
only one occasion is described
the approach differed each time
patterns.question: What would the run of these occasions have to look like for you to stop?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account where the approach never once paid
patterns.basis: Described in work on intermittent reinforcement.

patterns.name: Time alone after time among people
patterns.statement: A stretch among people was followed by a need for quiet, or by its absence.
holds_when: the account describes extended company
it says what they needed or did afterwards
what followed is described
not_when: the company was brief and unremarked
nothing about afterwards is given
they were alone throughout
patterns.question: Was there a long stretch of company that left you with energy rather than needing quiet?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account of extended company followed by no need for recovery
patterns.basis: Described in work on social load and recovery.

patterns.name: What someone said changed the course
patterns.statement: Another person said something and the account says what was done about it.
holds_when: someone else's words are reported
the account says whether they were taken up or set aside
what followed is described
not_when: nobody else features
the words were noted with no action either way
what followed is absent
patterns.question: What decides whether you act on what someone tells you?
patterns.retiring_answer: An account where what was said made no difference either way
patterns.basis: Described in work on feedback and its uptake.
